title: A textbook table says 4-year-olds prefer playing with others over playing alone
summary: OpenStax's milestone table lists, at age 4, a preference for social play over playing alone.
body: In Table 9.4 the age-4 personal and social cell says the child prefers social play to solo play, and knows likes and interests. That is the textbook's wording for a shift toward company. It is not the CDC 3-year line about joining children who are already playing, and it has no percent attached. The table is a teaching summary. Preferences vary, and the cell is not a diagnosis.
